title: E-FRC-0306: explores whether the one-walker electron (the colour-blind Lambda^3 walker, det R = 1) keeps its chiral...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0306 in the gauge arena: explores whether the one-walker electron (the colour-blind Lambda^3 walker, det R = 1) keeps its chiral wall at its own charge 3: R*'s domain-wall slab under a U(1) probe with every phase tripled, read for the Laughlin pump and wall index, the Landau g and the leak, against the same reads at charge 1.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
